description: Ships NO CODE. Declares and pins the Desert Ant Labs Emo LiteRT artifact set and serves on-device emoji suggestions through the host's model-runtime lane: tool suggest_emojis backed by the emo/text-v1 processor.

tools.name: suggest_emojis
tools.description: Suggest emojis for a piece of text on device: the top labels by probability with their confidences.

skills.name: suggest-emojis
skills.description: Use suggest_emojis to suggest emojis for user text on device; suggestions are ranked probabilities, not promises or calibrated confidence.
